connections.description: Credentials and endpoints for the services integrations talk to.

scopes.description: The tree of scopes: what each watches, how its Work runs and what it may do.

includes.description: Folders whose .open-conduit/config.json adds scopes beneath parent, a scope of this file. path is absolute or relative to this file's directory.

path.description: The folder holding .open-conduit/config.json, absolute or relative to this file's directory (no ~).

parent.description: A scope defined in this file that the folder's scopes sit beneath.

concurrency.description: Most agent turns (claude-code and installed extension executors) running at once across every scope. A scope's limits.concurrency can only narrow it. Takes effect when the next config generation is applied with open-conduit config apply; editing the file or restarting serve alone changes nothing.

job_concurrency.description: Most job attempts (the shell and github-hold executors) running at once, counted apart from concurrency so a busy agent pool never holds a due job back. Takes effect when the next config generation is applied with open-conduit config apply; editing the file or restarting serve alone changes nothing.

admission_limit.description: Reserved for a cap on claimed Work per scope. Validated but not enforced: config check warns where a config sets it.

reconcile_seconds.description: How often each source (a repository, a tracker, a Slack workspace, a schedule) is reconciled against its service, so missed webhooks cost only this much latency. Sources added by a later generation (open-conduit config apply) use the new value; bundled sources already running keep theirs until serve restarts on that generation.

timeout_seconds.description: The deadline of one attempt (an Execution) before the host stops it. A binding's own timeout_seconds replaces it for that binding. Takes effect when the next config generation is applied with open-conduit config apply; editing the file or restarting serve alone changes nothing. An attempt already running keeps the deadline it started with.

kept_executions.description: Executions per Work whose content (logs, transcripts, outputs) is kept; older ones are released by the retention sweep. Their coordination history (trigger, timing, outcome, usage) is never deleted. Takes effect when the next config generation is applied with open-conduit config apply; editing the file or restarting serve alone changes nothing.

kept_finished_days.description: Days a finished Work keeps its attempts' content (logs, transcripts, outputs) after it last changed; the retention sweep then releases all of it. Coordination history is never deleted. Takes effect when the next config generation is applied with open-conduit config apply; editing the file or restarting serve alone changes nothing.

retry_delays_seconds.description: The wait before each retry of a failed attempt, in order; once they are used up automatic retries stop and the Work stays open for an operator to retry. Usage-limit retries wait for the reported reset instead. Takes effect when the next config generation is applied with open-conduit config apply; editing the file or restarting serve alone changes nothing.

causal_max_depth.description: How many Events one chain of causes may reach (an Event caused by an execution that an Event started, and so on). The Event past it is refused with a depth_limit diagnostic, which stops feedback loops without the extension's cooperation. Takes effect when the next config generation is applied with open-conduit config apply; editing the file or restarting serve alone changes nothing.

causal_per_minute.description: How many Events one causal chain may add per minute; a burst past it is refused. Takes effect when the next config generation is applied with open-conduit config apply; editing the file or restarting serve alone changes nothing.

budgets.description: Usage limits the host enforces before it starts a turn: at most max of unit per Work, per scope or across every scope, over the Work's life or each UTC day or week. Work over a limit is held with the reason.

unit.description: attempts and turns are counted by the host; any other unit (usd, tokens, minutes, ...) is what executors report.

webhooks.description: The webhook listener and tunnel serve starts with; serve flags override it for one run. Without it the daemon is reconcile-only. Takes effect at the next serve start after the generation holding it is applied with open-conduit config apply.

addr.description: Local address the listener binds, such as 127.0.0.1:8787.

tunnel.description: How the listener is reached from outside: ngrok, cloudflared, or static (public_url already reaches it).

tunnel_name.description: The cloudflared named tunnel to run.

public_url.description: The URL services deliver webhooks to, for tunnel static.

connections.description: Connection IDs this scope (and its bindings) may use.

operations.description: Toolbelt operations executions in this scope may call (see the operations reference): an operation, a toolset an extension publishes as `@<name>` (every operation it has in the running release), or either denied with a leading `!`. A binding's operations narrow it.

read_scopes.description: Other scopes whose Events this scope's executions may wait on.

file_scopes.description: Other scopes whose trackers this scope's agents may file issues in and comment on.

id.description: Stable ID that scopes, bindings and extension entries name.

type.description: The integration that owns it (open-conduit adapters lists them).

config.description: The integration's connection fields (open-conduit adapters TYPE).

secret_refs.description: Secret name to reference (keyring:NAME, file:NAME, env:VAR or cmd:COMMAND); values never appear in the config.

interrupt.description: The executor must support interrupting a running attempt.

inject.description: The executor must accept messages into a running attempt.

resume.description: The executor must resume a parked attempt's session.

workspace.description: The executor must run in a workspace.

toolbelt.description: How the executor reaches the toolbelt.

name.description: Name routes and Work refer to.

executor.description: The registered executor that runs attempts.

connection.description: Connection the executor's tools act through.

requires.description: Capabilities the executor must declare; binding fails closed otherwise.

operations.description: Narrows the scope's authorization.operations for this binding: operations, toolsets as `@<name>` and denials with a leading `!`, as there. A toolset is narrowed to what the scope grants.

secret_names.description: Scope secrets the executor may resolve.

resource.description: Resource provider and its config (such as a git workspace).

sandbox.description: Process sandbox provider and its config.

container.description: Container provider and its config, pinned to an image digest.

timeout_seconds.description: Replaces settings.timeout_seconds for this binding's attempts.

pass_env.description: Variables of the daemon's environment this binding's runs, and its workspace's git commands and setup, see (a proxy, SSH_AUTH_SOCK, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). Never OS_* or OPEN_CONDUIT_*, nor one an env: secret reference names.

config.description: The executor's own config (open-conduit adapters TYPE).

grants.description: Named sets of extra operations and config a Work can opt into.

binding.description: How Work is executed: an executor and what it is given. {"name", "disabled": true} turns off an inherited binding.

handler.description: The registered route handler that matches Events.

active_policy.description: What a matching Event does while the Work already has an attempt running: queue it for the next attempt, drop it, inject it into the running attempt, or interrupt the attempt.

unsupported_fallback.description: What to do when the executor cannot inject or interrupt as active_policy asks.

error_fallback.description: What to do when injecting or interrupting fails.

config.description: The handler's own config (open-conduit adapters TYPE).

route.description: Which Events start or reach Work, and with which binding. {"name", "disabled": true} turns off an inherited route.

connection.description: Connection it reads and writes through.

extension.description: An extension entry: an integration watching a source for this scope. {"name", "disabled": true} turns off an inherited entry.

parent.description: Parent scope; a child inherits its bindings, routes, extensions and authorization, and can only narrow them.

enabled.description: false stops new Work and attempts in the scope and its descendants.

concurrency.description: Most attempts running in this scope at once, at most the parent's.

authorization.description: What executions in the scope may do. Omitted, a child inherits its parent's; given, each list must be a subset of the parent's.
